summary: Full-stack testing of Property Technical Record v1 (Dosar Tehnic). Backend: 21/21 pytest passed covering vocabulary, technical-record aggregation, building context (create/patch non-destructive, unverified default), diagnostics (missing jurisdiction → 422, unknown → 400, FR/RO create as unverified/declared for owner, documented for admin — never verified auto, PATCH with history, DELETE soft-remove), transaction-readiness with exact 10 criteria and worst-case overall_status (no numeric score), and 5 existing endpoints (dna/completeness/timeline/documents/assets) unaffected. Frontend: PropertyHubV2 sub-nav 'hub-subnav-dosar' loads PropertyTechnicalRecord with header (name/address/status badge), 7 desktop sections (ptr-nav-*), diagnostics CRUD with Neverificat + jurisdiction badges, readiness with 10 criteria and disclaimer, building context Neverificat, and mobile accordion (ptr-mobile-toggle-*) with ptr-nav hidden on 390x844. Everything works as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: property_technical_record.py is ~770 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into vocab/building_context/diagnostics/readiness modules for maintainability.
`_by_jurisdiction` and `_serialize_building` are pure helpers — could be shared/tested in isolation.
PATCH /api/buildings/{id}/context authorization uses count_documents on properties.building_id — works but couples routes; acceptable for v1.
PropertyTechnicalRecord.jsx uses browser `window.confirm` and `alert` for UX; consider replacing with app toast/modal for consistency.
`emptyDiagForm(vocab)` accepts a param but ignores it (arrow signature `= ()`); harmless but misleading.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_iter181 diagnostics on property 6a11d70e600be19667009c93 (FR + RO + admin FR) and deletes them via module-scope teardown. Building context on Skyline Loft A4 is updated with number_of_units=42 during the merge test (non-destructive; construction_year preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PTR v1 is production-ready. All 3 domain boundaries respected: A (property_core) unchanged, B (buildings.context) non-destructive merge, C (property_diagnostics) isolated collection starting unverified. FR/RO treated as distinct jurisdictions. Transaction Readiness returns 10 status-only criteria (COMPLETE/PARTIAL/MISSING/NOT_VERIFIED) with worst-case overall_status and no numeric score. Frontend testids stable: property-technical-record, ptr-nav, ptr-nav-{core|building|diagnostics|systems|documents|history|readiness}, ptr-mobile-toggle-{...}, ptr-diag-{add-btn|save|remove-*|verif-*|jur-*}, ptr-building-{verif|save}, ptr-readiness-overall, ptr-crit-status-*, ptr-header-{name|address|status}.
